Exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid on 1536x1024 canvas; 512x512 cells. Chronological reading order. Same camera, scale and identity in every cell, right-facing three-quarter. Subject total height approx 330px, 70px CLEAR transparent padding. Whole cap/body/arms/feet/effects inside each own cell with no overlap. Opaque subject interior, genuine transparent background, no floor, shadow, colored haze, text, labels, borders, scenery or other creatures. Do not copy reference layout. Sporeling exact reference cap/body. STRICT SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT in every cell, keep only one eye visible. Six distinct chronological walking poses with BOTH FEET clearly visible: 1 leading foot stretched far RIGHT and trailing foot far LEFT; 2 front foot flat planted, rear heel lifts; 3 rear foot passes under body and leading knee bends, body rises; 4 opposite foot now swings far RIGHT while other foot trails LEFT, cap dips; 5 new front foot planted and old front heel lifts; 6 feet passing close under torso again before next cycle. Short root arms counter-swing. DO NOT repeat same forward kick three times. Different contact/down/pass/up shapes, stable side camera. Every foot inside cell.
